name: The water's marks shared by every edge type (edge_layer.py EDGE_LAYER_CODE)

levels.HighZ: +0.30 m: top of the stain band (spring highs)
levels.LowZ: -1.25 m: the lowest recent water (dry autumns)
levels.WrackZ: +0.15 m: where sticks and leaves come to rest
levels.Swash: 0.20 m: wet height above the water in a light breeze (Track I can drive it from fetch and wind)
levels.WaterZ: the lake now (MPC_World, the game's lake level; -0.98 m on the Oct 11 2026 gauge)

real: A reservoir that rises and falls a metre or more marks everything on its edge: a silt band between its usual lowest and highest water, ringed by the steps of each fall, a pale dried scum at the top, olive algae on what is under water most of the year (a grey-green crust when a low lake leaves it dry), the wet line where the waves wash, run-off under drains and bolts, and a wrack line of sticks and leaves at the high water.

owned_elsewhere.foam and ripple edge: the water material, Mac, after Nov 21 (water edge)
owned_elsewhere.zebra mussels: unchecked for Ray Hubbard; a cluster layer below the pool if it is infested
